logline: One real, world-famous city in the year 2512, and the advanced technology it built to live better than it ever has.
kurulum_notu: 13 Eylul 2026'da kuruldu (flashpoints'in yerine) ve AYNI GUN CANLIYA ALINDI. Ihsan karari: 'tamam bunu paylasalim, yeni pipeline bunu yerlestirelim, her gun yeni bir populer sehir olsun'. Ilk bolum ISTANBUL 2512 elle yayinlandi, sonrasi still-home.yml 20:30 UTC cron'una birakildi. publish_mode=auto, canli gunluk seridin (wild-encounter) filo gelenegiyle ayni. Durdurmak icin: status='paused' + still-home.yml schedule blogunu yorumla. | 2026-09-15 v2.0 (Ihsan iki direktifi): (1) 'daha hizli gecisler lazim tek videoda 3 sahne gecisi istiyorum' -> 2 cekim 4 cekime cikti, micro_trim 0,75 ile bolum 4 x 2,5 = 10,0 sn ve 3 sert kesme tasiyor. (2) 'ortamlari daha futuristik yapmani istiyorum robotik gelecek gibi olsun, videolar hep bi yikimdan sonrasini gosteriyor gibi olmus, onun yerine teknolojinin nasil gelistigini anlatan bir video olsun' -> konsept yikim-sonrasi uyarlamadan ILERI TEKNOLOJIYE cevrildi: alti aile de degisti, 36 konunun 36'si yeniden yazildi, art_style ve qc.notes felaket estetigini otomatik fail sayiyor.

auto_replenish.title_style: the city and what it built, stated plainly, in the pattern '<Real City> <what it built>' (e.g. 'Paris Runs On Its Own Tower', 'Tokyo Grows Everything It Eats', 'London Built A Road To Orbit'). Max 70 characters. The city MUST be a real, world-famous one and MUST be the first word, and what follows MUST name an achievement the city built, never a disaster it endured. No clickbait punctuation, no hashtags, no surrounding quotes, no question marks, no year in the title (the year lives on the title card), no first-person claim of having filmed anything.
auto_replenish.caption_style:
"caption" = the entire WRITTEN STORY because the video has zero narration, and it is BILINGUAL: an English block first, then a blank line, then the SAME story in the CITY'S OWN LOCAL LANGUAGE. The local language is given by the chosen topic's "local_language" field (Istanbul -> Turkish, Tokyo -> Japanese, Berlin -> German, Cairo -> Arabic, and so on). English is ALWAYS first; the second block speaks to the people who actually live there.
- ENGLISH BLOCK: 60-120 words of lean, specific prose in five short blocks separated with \n\n. Follow this exact order: (1) name the real city and say in one sentence what it BUILT; (2) say plainly how that changed ordinary life for the better; (3) give two or three concrete, picturable details of a day there now (how people move, what the machines do, what is grown or made, what the light is like); (4) write the exact standalone sentence "A fictional future, created with AI."; (5) close with ONE concrete question about how the viewer would live there.
- The tone is confident and warm, never a survival story: this city is thriving because of what it engineered. Write about an achievement, never about a catastrophe it endured.
- LOCAL-LANGUAGE BLOCK: the same five beats written naturally in that language, NOT a literal translation. Use the script that language is actually written in (Japanese in Japanese script, Arabic in Arabic script, Russian in Cyrillic). Keep sentences short and plain. Step (4) is the same disclosure sentence rendered naturally in that language, and step (5) is the same question.
- WHEN THE LOCAL LANGUAGE IS ENGLISH (New York, London, Sydney, Toronto and similar), write the English block ONLY and stop. Never repeat the same English text twice.
- Omit any number you are not sure of. Avoid em dashes.
- HASHTAGS: "hashtags" = 6-9 specific, space-separated tags covering the named city, the technology shown, and 3-4 broad future, engineering, robotics or AI categories. Always include #STILLHOME2512. Write the tags ONCE in Latin script, never split them per language. Each tag starts with # and contains no spaces; skip generic engagement tags.
shot_plan: Shot 1, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, AERIAL. The camera flies high in the open sky, far ABOVE every rooftop, tower and mast in the city, and looks DOWN on it from there. The whole city lies below the camera and spreads across the frame from edge to edge; the horizon and open sky sit in the top third. Think satellite, helicopter or drone at altitude. The very first frame already contains BOTH the real city's recognisable landmark or skyline AND the advanced technology this episode is about, built at city scale and visibly running, so a viewer who sees only this one frame already knows which city it is and what it became. Something inside the city MOVES independently of the camera for the whole four seconds: transit pods travelling their line, craft crossing their corridor, cargo drones streaming between towers, light pulsing along a structure. One slow, single-direction camera move only, a straight descent or a forward glide, and the camera stays outdoors and above the structures for the entire four seconds. The shot holds one continuous unbroken view from first frame to last.

Shot 2, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, GROUND LEVEL. After a hard cut, the camera stands at human eye height in a busy public place in the SAME city, at a completely different vantage point from shot 1. People go about ordinary daily life around the technology, walking, riding, trading, carrying and queueing, while autonomous machines work alongside them at the same easy pace. Every human figure reads at roughly one sixth of the frame height or smaller and stands in the middle ground or further back, seen from behind or in three-quarter view, so the crowd reads as movement and warmth at a distance. The nearest third of the frame is held by architecture, machinery, planting or open floor. Warm practical light from windows, canopies, lamps and the technology's own glow falls across the scene. Surfaces carry painted symbols and plain colour fields, so every surface stays clear of lettering. The same recognisable landmark stays readable in the background or on the horizon so the shots read as one city. One slow, single-direction camera move only, at a constant height.

Shot 3, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, MACHINE SCALE. After a hard cut, the camera is close to the advanced technology itself while it works: an autonomous builder arm laying material, a transit pod sliding through its guide, an energy column drawing light up its length, a fabricator filling a crate, a machine-tended canopy of growing green. The mechanism fills most of the frame and its motion is continuous, purposeful, precise and unhurried. Machined metal, glass and structural light carry fine surface detail. The recognisable landmark or skyline stays visible past the mechanism so the city remains identified. Human presence reads only as small distant figures far behind the machine. One slow, single-direction camera move only.

Shot 4, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, WARM DETAIL. After a hard cut, the camera rests close on one small piece of everyday home life inside this advanced city: a lit balcony thick with plants above a glowing street, a small delivery drone settling onto a window ledge, laundry moving in warm air beside a luminous wall panel, a cat asleep on a warm machined sill, steam rising from a food counter, a child's bicycle leaning against a rail of light. The detail fills the frame and is lit warmly from inside the home. Motion is gentle and continuous: leaves stirring, steam curling, light breathing, the drone settling. Any person present reads as a small silhouette or a shoulder passing at the frame edge, well behind the subject. A sliver of the recognisable skyline or landmark sits softly out of focus in the background so the place stays identified. One slow, single-direction camera move only.
auto_replenish.brief:
SONSUZ ILERI-TEKNOLOJI SEHRI ANTOLOJISI. Her bolum, gercek ve dunyaca taninan TEK bir sehrin 2512 yilindaki halini DORT CEKIMDE gosterir. Anlatilan sey sehrin basina gelen bir felaket DEGIL, sehrin KURDUGU TEKNOLOJIDIR. Gorsel promptlar ve caption Ingilizce yazilir.

DEGISMEZ KURALLAR:
(1) TANINIR GERCEK SEHIR. Sehri gercek adiyla kullan ve onu ilk karede tanitan dunyaca bilinen EN AZ BIR yapi ya da siluet secilsin (Ayasofya, Eyfel, Empire State, Burj Khalifa, Tokyo Kulesi, Kolezyum, Opera Binasi gibi). Uydurma sehir, isimsiz kubbe, jenerik sci-fi manzara YASAK. Olculdu: ayni kanalda taninir sehir 46.042 begeni aldi, isimsiz kubbe 124.
(2) ILERLEME, FELAKET DEGIL. Her bolumun tek mesaji sudur: teknoloji ilerledi ve sehir bu sayede daha iyi yasiyor. Bolumun konusu sehri bir tehditten KORUYAN bir siginak degil, sehre yeni bir yetenek KAZANDIRAN calisan bir teknolojidir. Yukselen deniz, col, sel, kuraklik, firtina, iklim siginagi, set, deniz duvari, golgeleme ortusu gibi savunma ve hayatta-kalma temalari YASAK. Harabe, catlak, moloz, derme catma yapi, branda, terk edilmislik, duman, yangin, panik, savas, silah da YASAK.
(3) TEKNOLOJI GORUNUR VE CALISIR DURUMDA. Her bolumde TEK ve acikca adlandirilmis bir teknoloji vardir ve kadrajda calisirken gorunur: manyetik ulasim hatti, otonom insaat makinesi, enerji kulesi, kendini onaran yapi malzemesi, otomatik uretim tesisi, yorunge asansoru. Ikinci bir buyuk teknoloji ekleme. Sadece 'parlak sehir' yetmez, MEKANIZMA gorunmelidir.
(4) TANINIR YAPI AYAKTA VE SISTEME BAGLI. 2512 cok uzak bir yil. Taninir yapi yikilmaz ve muzelik de kalmaz: yeni teknolojinin bir parcasi olur. Eyfel bir enerji omurgasinin govdesidir, Ayasofya bir manyetik hattin durak meydanidir. Taninirlik korunur, gecen zaman da okunur.
(5) DORT CEKIM, UC SERT KESME, DORT AYRI OLCEK. Cekim 1 HAVADAN (sehir olcegi, kanca). Cekim 2 YER SEVIYESI (insanlar ve makineler birlikte, gunluk hayat). Cekim 3 MAKINE OLCEGI (teknolojinin kendisi calisirken, yakindan). Cekim 4 SICAK AYRINTI (bir evin isigi, bir saksi, bir teslimat dronu). Kesmeler eslesen hareket DEGIL, olcek sicramasidir.
(6) ILK KARE TAM VAATTIR. Cekim 1'in ilk karesi hem taninir sehri hem de teknolojisini ayni anda gosterir; yalniz o tek kareyi goren biri sehri tanimali ve neyin degistigini anlamalidir. Kurulum, yaklasma, gecikmeli ortaya cikis yasaktir. Ayrica cekim 1'de kameradan BAGIMSIZ bir hareket bulunmalidir (gecen arac, akan drone, yuruyen isik): ilk saniyede donuk duran kadraj kaydirilir.
(7) TEK YONLU KAMERA. Her cekimde tek, yavas, tek yonlu bir hareket. Pan, orbit, takip, sarsinti, zoom salinimi, cekim ICINDE kesme ve sahne sifirlamasi yok.
(8) INSAN OLCEGI KUCUK KALIR. Insanlar orta plandan geriye, kare yuksekliginin en fazla alti'da biri kadar, arkadan ya da uc-ceyrek acidan gorunur. Yuz yakin plani, tam kare dolduran figur ve on planda el yok. Bu bir estetik tercih degil, QC'nin anatomi kapisidir: 15 Eylul'de part 3 tam bu yuzden dustu.
(9) POZITIF VIDEO DILI. Gorsel prompt yalniz kadrajda BULUNAN seyleri soyler. Su Ingilizce sozcukleri gorsel paragrafta kullanma: no, not, never, nothing, without, avoid, cannot, absent, lacks, lacking. 'Instead of' kalibini da kullanma.
(10) YAZI ISTEME. Tabela, pano, ekran, hologram yazisi, afis, marka ve logo gorsel promptta GECMEZ. Yazinin isini boyali sembol ve duz renk alani yapar. qc.notes okunabilir yaziyi otomatik fail sayar, yani istedigin sey seni dusuruyor.
(11) SES: TEK DERIN DRONE. Anlatim, konusma ve ritmik muzik YOKTUR. 'music' alani TEK bir surekli derin ugultu tarif eder: dusuk frekansli, sabit seviyeli, vurussuz, melodisiz, tiz icermeyen, baslangic ve bitis vurgusu olmayan. Referansta olculdu: 20Hz-2kHz duz, 2-8kHz 29 dB asagida, 8kHz ustu yok.
(12) KUNYE MOTORUN ISI. 'title_card' alani {"title": "<SEHIR> 2512", "subtitle": ""} bicimindedir, sehir adi BUYUK harfle. Videonun icinde okunabilir yazi, altyazi, logo, filigran URETME: kunye sonradan ffmpeg ile biner.
(13) BASLIK SEHIRDIR. En fazla 70 karakter, ilk kelime gercek sehir adi, sonra sehrin NE KURDUGU. Tiklama tuzagi, soru isareti, hashtag ve yil kullanma.
(14) CAPTION HIKAYEYI TASIR VE IKI DILLIDIR. Once Ingilizce blok: 60-120 kelime, sehri ve kurdugu teknolojiyi adlandir, bunun gunluk hayati nasil degistirdigini soyle, iki-uc somut ayrinti ver, 'A fictional future, created with AI.' cumlesini aynen yaz ve tek somut soruyla bitir. Sonra bos satir, sonra AYNI hikaye SEHRIN KENDI DILINDE: hangi dil oldugu secilen konunun 'local_language' alaninda yazili (Istanbul Turkce, Tokyo Japonca, Berlin Almanca, Kahire Arapca...). O dilin gercek yazi sistemini kullan. Kisa cumle, sade dil, em-dash yok. Amac o sehrin KENDI HALKINA hitap etmek. YEREL DIL INGILIZCE ISE (New York, Londra, Sydney, Toronto gibi) yalniz Ingilizce blok yazilir, ayni metin iki kez tekrarlanmaz. Hashtag'ler TEK sefer ve Latin harfleriyle.
(15) AILE VE CESITLILIK. Yalniz kanonik ailelerden birini aynen sec. Ardisik iki bolum ayni aileden olamaz. Ayni sehri tekrar kullanma ve onceki bolumun teknolojisini hafifce degistirip tekrar etme.

topic_pool.topic: Istanbul in 2512: magnetic transit rings arc over the Bosphorus on slender lit spans and Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque stand at the station squares beneath them.
New York in 2512: autonomous climbing builders extend Manhattan's towers in the open air and the Empire State Building is the anchor they work outward from.
Paris in 2512: the Eiffel Tower has become the city's energy spine, drawing light up its full height and feeding a skyline that glows from its own power.
Dubai in 2512: Burj Khalifa is sheathed in living engineered material that grows, mends itself and glows softly along every edge of the city.
Tokyo in 2512: Tokyo Tower and Skytree rise above automated growing halls and machine-run workshops that make everything the city eats and uses.
London in 2512: an orbital elevator ribbon climbs from the Thames into the sky and Tower Bridge and Big Ben stand at the foot of its terminal.
Cairo in 2512: magnetic transit lines run straight across the Giza plateau and the Pyramids stand beside the lit spans that carry the city to them.
Rome in 2512: autonomous conservators keep the Colosseum perfect stone by stone while machine crews raise new districts across the seven hills.
Sydney in 2512: the Opera House shells sit among tidal and solar arrays that light the whole harbour from the water's own motion.
Venice in 2512: St Mark's Campanile rises from decks of living engineered stone that mend themselves and glow gently across the lagoon at night.
Agra in 2512: the Taj Mahal faces terraces of automated growing halls that make the whole plain green and feed the city from its own ground.
Hong Kong in 2512: Victoria Harbour is an orbital port and shuttles rise between the peaks past a skyline that still reads exactly as itself.
Rio de Janeiro in 2512: Christ the Redeemer looks out over magnetic transit lines that carry the city between the hills on slender lit spans high above the slopes.
San Francisco in 2512: autonomous builders continuously extend and renew the Golden Gate Bridge, widening it into a working spine of the bay city.
Moscow in 2512: tall fusion light towers warm and illuminate the whole city and St Basil's Cathedral stands bright beneath them through the winter.
Athens in 2512: the Acropolis is built of living marble that repairs itself and the city below is faced in the same quietly luminous stone.
Barcelona in 2512: the Sagrada Familia stands at the centre of a district of automated workshops and growing towers that supply the whole city.
Singapore in 2512: an orbital tether rises from Marina Bay and Marina Bay Sands sits at the base of the ribbon that carries cargo to the sky.
Beijing in 2512: magnetic transit rings circle the Forbidden City on lit elevated lines that move the whole capital above its own streets.
Amsterdam in 2512: autonomous machines rebuild and maintain the canal rings continuously and the old gabled fronts are kept perfect by their crews.
Mumbai in 2512: the Gateway of India stands before a coastline of energy towers that light the entire city from the sea and the sun.
Bangkok in 2512: Wat Arun rises among towers of living engineered material that flower along the canals and light the water after dark.
Shanghai in 2512: the Oriental Pearl Tower stands among automated fabrication towers that make everything the city needs on the spot.
Petra in 2512: the rock-cut facades look out on a canyon launch terrace where orbital shuttles rise silently between the cliff walls.
Marrakesh in 2512: the Koutoubia minaret stands over magnetic caravan lines that run straight out across the plain on low lit spans.
Seoul in 2512: Namsan Tower crowns a city that autonomous builders reshape and renew continuously, floor by floor, while people live in it.
Berlin in 2512: the Brandenburg Gate opens onto boulevards lit and powered by luminous energy columns that run the length of every avenue.
Lisbon in 2512: the 25 de Abril Bridge spans a Tagus lined with hillsides of living engineered stone that glows warmly through the evening.
Mexico City in 2512: the Angel of Independence stands among automated growing halls that supply the whole valley from inside the city itself.
Toronto in 2512: the CN Tower stands beside the base of an orbital tether and climbers rise from the lakefront into the sky all day.
Chicago in 2512: magnetic transit lines run out over Lake Michigan and the Willis Tower anchors a lakefront skyline threaded with lit elevated spans.
Machu Picchu in 2512: autonomous builders have continued the Inca terraces upward into a living high city that the same stonework still carries.
Cape Town in 2512: Table Mountain overlooks a coast of wind and tidal energy arrays that trace the shoreline in steady light.
Alexandria in 2512: the Qaitbay Citadel stands beside a harbour of living engineered sea-stone that repairs itself and glows along the waterline.
Las Vegas in 2512: the Strip stands over automated production halls and desert growing towers that make the whole valley self-supplying.
Reykjavik in 2512: Hallgrimskirkja stands beside a northern spaceport and orbital shuttles rise into the aurora above the city.

auto_replenish.shot_plan_note: 2026-09-15 v2.0 (Ihsan): 2 cekim -> 4 cekim, 3 sert gecis. micro_trim 0,75 ile her ham 4 sn klip 2,5 sn'ye iner, bolum 10,0 sn olur (olculen referans kazanani 10,1 sn). Cekimler OLCEK sirasina gore dizildi: havadan -> yer seviyesi -> makine -> sicak ayrinti. Odul (insanlar) 4,0 sn yerine 2,5 sn'de gelir. v1.1 dersi korunuyor: cekim 2 sablonu iki kapiya birden carpiyordu, (a) 'signage' istiyordu ama qc.notes okunabilir yaziyi otomatik fail sayiyor, (b) 'People fill the frame' + goz hizasi kalabalik QC'nin SIKI anatomi kapisi icin en riskli kompozisyon. Figurler artik kare yuksekliginin 1/6'si ve orta plandan geriye; on ucte bir bos. Cekim 3 ve 4 zaten insansiz, yani dort cekimin yalniz BIRI anatomi riski tasiyor.
